original: kupitia mkusanyiko yanaoweza kuzalisha
suggestion: kupitia mkusanyiko unaoweza kuuzalisha
reason: Agreement error: mkusanyiko is singular, so the relative must be unaoweza, not yanaoweza.

original: kiasi cha usafiri bidhaa inahitaji
suggestion: kiasi cha usafiri ambacho bidhaa inahitaji
reason: Broken noun phrase; missing relative marker makes the clause unreadable.

original: Tanzania, mradi wa nickel wa Kabanga unapanga
suggestion: Nchini Tanzania, mradi wa nickel wa Kabanga unapanga
reason: Dangling topic comma; reads as a broken sentence rather than a location adverbial.

original: Kuondoa vyuma vilivyopotea kabla ya crusher na vinu
suggestion: Kuondoa vyuma vya kigeni kabla ya crusher na vinu
reason: vilivyopotea means lost/misplaced metal; tramp iron is foreign/stray metal (vyuma vya kigeni).

original: hukaushwa na kuchujwa, mara nyingi kwenye filter press
suggestion: huchujwa na kunyeshwa maji, mara nyingi kwenye filter press
reason: Wrong process and order: a filter press dewaters/filters; kukaushwa means drying, and the order is reversed.

original: kutenganisha ilmenite na rutile na zircon
suggestion: kutenganisha ilmenite kutoka rutile na zircon
reason: Current wording lists three products side by side; magnetics separate ilmenite from non-magnetic rutile and zircon.

original: jinsi ya kuyatofautisha na kuuza madini kwa mchakataji kunahusisha nini
suggestion: jinsi ya kuyatofautisha na nini kinahusika katika kuuza madini kwa mchakataji
reason: Parallel structure is broken and confuses “how to distinguish” with “what selling involves”.

original: birika lililoinama
suggestion: tanki lililoinama
reason: birika means kettle/boiler; a Tanzanian reader will misread the classifier trough/tank.

original: kupandishwa kwenye birika na skrubu
suggestion: kupandishwa kwenye tanki na skrubu
reason: Same wrong word: classifier tank is tanki, not birika.

original: majaribio ya kimiminika kizito na DMS na flotation
suggestion: majaribio ya DMS (kimiminika kizito) na flotation
reason: DMS and kimiminika kizito are the same method; listing both looks like two different tests.

original: viwango vya kaboni vya kati ya 90 na zaidi kwa asilimia
suggestion: viwango vya kaboni vya asilimia 90 na zaidi
reason: kati ya 90 na zaidi is unnatural and unclear; grade is stated as 90% and above.

original: mchanganyiko unaohitajika na madini
suggestion: mchanganyiko unaohitajika kulingana na madini
reason: unaohitajika na madini is ambiguous (needed and ore / needed by ore); means the mix required for that ore.

original: Za kimakanika zinazojinyonyea hewa
suggestion: Za kimakanika zinazojivuta hewa
reason: jinyonyea is unnatural; self-aspirated cells are described as kujivuta hewa.

original: kabla msambazaji yeyote hajaweza kutoa bei
suggestion: kabla msambazaji yeyote aweze kutoa bei
reason: hajaweza misfits the “before anyone can” sense; subjunctive aweze is the natural form after kabla.

original: Hupanuliwa kutoka kasi ya flotation ya maabara na msanifu
suggestion: Hupanuliwa na msanifu kutoka kasi ya flotation ya maabara
reason: Word order makes it read as “from lab rate and the designer” instead of scaled up by the designer.

original: Vifaa vya gravity hupanga chembe kwa uzito wake
suggestion: Vifaa vya gravity hupanga chembe kwa msongamano wake
reason: Gravity separation sorts by density; uzito conflicts with the article’s own msongamano explanation.

original: ndani ya birika lililoinama
suggestion: ndani ya tanki lililoinama
reason: Same birika error in the product summary.

original: skrubu ndani ya birika lililoinama
suggestion: skrubu ndani ya tanki lililoinama
reason: FAQ repeats birika for the classifier tank; use tanki for consistency and clarity.

original: kiwango cha shimo la kuchimba
suggestion: kiwango cha madini yanayochimbwa
reason: shimo la kuchimba is a calque of pit grade and sounds odd; readers expect grade of mined ore.

original: Kwa vitendo hapana
suggestion: Kwa praktiki hapana
reason: Optional: kwa vitendo is understandable, but kwa praktisi/praktiki is the usual mining-register equivalent of “in practice.”
